k-honden-C1.site: 春日大社 本社本殿
k-honden-C1.orientation: Each gable entrance faces south. The buildings form an east–west row. The north–south ridge runs fore to aft.
k-honden-C1.measuredRepresentation: One representative structure of four, as labeled in the measured drawing. Numeric callouts below appear on plan 3 and longitudinal section 7.
k-honden-C1.heightDatum: Reference is the lower foundation/plinth line in longitudinal section 7; the upper extension meets the level of the horizontal ridge-top member. Excludes projecting chigi tips. No orthometric datum or DEM tie.
k-honden-C1.rights: Numerical facts and independently worded descriptions only. City and UNESCO graphics are not included.

k-heiden.site: 春日大社 幣殿・舞殿
k-heiden.use: eastern two bays Heiden; western three Buden
k-heiden.rights: Archived measured elevations are available for inspection; the University of Tokyo requires a separate procedure for image use. No drawing, tracing, or heights are supplied.
